parameters.content:
## Hermes digest – morning-digest
08:00 Europe/Athens → Talk room of profile nextcloud.

Nextcloud MCP server (http://nextcloud-mcp:8000/mcp, no auth, stateful session): nc_calendar_list_events on `personal` for today and nc_calendar_search_todos for the open to-dos of every live task list, grouped by list with due/overdue first. (The HTTP Request node does not send a body with PROPFIND/REPORT, so CalDAV is not called directly.) Template only, no LLM. No events and no open to-dos = no message.

Manual run = dry run: the result is returned, nothing is posted. Another workflow can call this one with {"dry_run": false|true, "use_llm": false, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. The workflow is its own error workflow: a failed scheduled run posts one line to the room. Credentials are created by n8n/scripts/hermes-digests-setup.sh.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "initialize", params: { protocolVersion: "2025-03-26", capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: "n8n-hermes-digest", version: "1.0" } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 2, method: 'tools/call', params: { name: 'nc_calendar_list_events', arguments: { calendar_name: 'personal', start_date: $('Run options').first().json.today, end_date: $('Run options').first().json.today, limit: 50 } } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 3, method: 'tools/call', params: { name: 'nc_calendar_search_todos', arguments: {} } }) }}
